findings.title: Removed `.title { float: left; }` rule without replacement
findings.body: The `.title` selector inside `.contents` that previously set `float: left;` was deleted entirely as part of converting `.contents` to flexbox, but no equivalent flex-based styling (e.g. explicit flex-grow/order) was added for `.title`. Since `.contents` is now `display: flex`, the title element will behave as a flex item with default properties, which may differ visually from the previous floated layout (e.g. losing its intended width/positioning relative to the logo and panel). This is a visible regression with no replacement styling.

findings.title: Dropped `.badge-wrapper.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }` rule
findings.body: The nested `&.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }` rule under `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper` was removed while adding flexbox ordering to `.extra-info-wrapper`. This silently changes the vertical alignment of bullet-style badges in the extra-info-wrapper with no equivalent replacement, likely causing a misalignment regression for topic badges.

findings.title: `.small-action-desc` padding change may cause overlap with icon
findings.body: The padding was changed from `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` (which reserved space for the 45px-wide `.topic-avatar` icon floated to the left) to `0 1.5%`. Since `.topic-avatar i` has a fixed `width: 45px`, a percentage-based padding of 1.5% will be smaller than 45px on most viewport widths, causing the icon and the description text to overlap instead of being properly spaced, especially combined with switching `.small-action` to flexbox (which no longer relies on float clearing the same way).

findings.title: Inconsistent mixin usage for already-cross-browser properties
findings.body: `.bullet` previously used plain `display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline;` (modern syntax, acceptable since other code already uses unprefixed flex properties elsewhere). Swapping to the `@include inline-flex()` / `@include align-items()` mixins adds back vendor-prefixed, mostly obsolete `-webkit-box`/`-moz-box` flexbox syntax (2009 spec) which is unnecessary for current browser support and increases generated CSS size without functional benefit.
